items.stem: Which activity best illustrates the finance function acting as a business partner rather than a scorekeeper?

options.text: Advising operational managers on the financial implications of strategic options
options.rationale: Correct: partnering means providing forward-looking decision support to the business.

options.text: Only recording historic transactions in the ledger
options.rationale: Recording history is the scorekeeping role, not partnering.

options.text: Filing statutory returns after the year end
options.rationale: Compliance filing is a stewardship task, not business partnering.

items.explanation: Correct: partnering means providing forward-looking decision support to the business.

items.stem: Which technology most directly enables an organisation to analyse very large and varied datasets for decision making?

options.rationale: Correct: big data analytics processes large, varied and fast-moving datasets for insight.
A filing cabinet cannot analyse large datasets.
A calculator cannot handle large, varied datasets.
A fax transmits documents and does not analyse data.

items.explanation: Correct: big data analytics processes large, varied and fast-moving datasets for insight.

items.stem: Select TWO characteristics that make information useful for management decision making.

options.text: It is relevant to the decision being taken
options.rationale: Correct: relevance is essential for decision-useful information.

options.text: It is sufficiently accurate and available in time
options.rationale: Correct: accuracy and timeliness make information fit for decisions.

options.text: It is as voluminous as possible regardless of need
options.rationale: Excess volume reduces, not improves, usefulness.

options.text: It is kept secret from the decision maker
options.rationale: Information withheld from the decision maker cannot be useful to them.

options.text: It is always expressed only in non-financial terms
options.rationale: Useful information may be financial or non-financial; restricting it is not a quality.

items.explanation: Correct: relevance is essential for decision-useful information.
items.domain_ref: Data and information in a digital world
